status: prospective protocol; formal payload gate remains closed
scientific_role: matched-data control for a first development experiment, not an original-paper reproduction

eligibility_before_ranking.stable_id: nonempty UTF-8 string; any missing ID is a dataset-wide hard failure; duplicate IDs are all rejected, not first-wins
eligibility_before_ranking.text: nonempty UTF-8 string; provenance hash is SHA256 of the exact raw UTF-8 bytes with no Unicode normalization
eligibility_before_ranking.script: FineWeb2 French and Spanish rows must declare Latn
eligibility_before_ranking.decontamination_gate: before formal selection, reject GlobalVoices hosts/URLs plus exact and near content matches under a separately frozen, result-blind rule; not yet implemented in wake10

rank.order: ascending 32-byte digest, then ascending exact stable_id bytes
properties: independent of text content and evaluation outcomes

training_representation.format: author --dict-input: one pretoken string and integer count per line; every serialized pretoken must contain no ASCII space, CR, or LF and must round-trip through the fixed author get_vocabulary parser
training_representation.reason: BPE consumes a token-frequency Counter, so dictionary input preserves the exact training multiset while permitting exact matched mass
training_representation.dependency: tokenizers==0.22.1 for the first development experiment; version is an added project freeze because the author pyproject is unpinned
training_representation.pa_bpe_dev_contract: the author applies one --dict-input switch to both training and dev files; therefore base/window runs with dev objectives must materialize every dev language with the identical pretokenizer into dict input too; ratio runs must pass no dev files
training_representation.native_validation_gate: before training, run minimal fixed-author Classical and PA-BPE commands for both supported contracts and verify their parsed Counters against generated hashes

budget.selection: walk eligible rows in rank order; reject rows yielding zero pretokens; include all pretokens from each row until the target; for the boundary row include only its deterministic pretoken prefix needed to hit the target exactly
budget.manifest: record row identity, rank, raw-text hash, available pretoken count, included prefix count, and source-shard identity
budget.warning: equal training pretoken mass is a data-balance control, not itself a fairness result

development_probe.limitations: first-row storage-order probes already exposed during source qualification; no formal sampling, benchmark scoring, or model comparison

gates.formal_payload_sampling: HOLD until decontamination rule, bounded-memory production selector, row-to-shard provenance, complete dependency/wheel lock, and selected-row manifest are verified
gates.tokenizer_training: HOLD until the formal payload gate passes
gates.fairness_claims: HOLD; wake10 can establish only protocol/software invariants
